import json, os, subprocess, sys, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

source=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
target=Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary")
req_id="sonary-daw-typecheck-stage-isolation-20261008-143"
sys.path.insert(0,str(source/"src"))
from do_again.service.rollout import _tree_hash

def run(args):
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(source/"src")
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=source,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env)

key=hashlib.sha256(str(target.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
control=root/"control"
receipt=control/"automation/do_again/receipts"/f"{req_id}.json"

receipt_state=None
receipt_obj=None
if receipt.is_file():
    try:
        receipt_obj=json.loads(receipt.read_text())
        receipt_state=receipt_obj.get("state")
    except Exception:
        receipt_state="unreadable"

terminal=receipt_state in {"succeeded","failed","cancelled","canceled"}

out={
  "request_id":req_id,
  "receipt_exists":receipt.is_file(),
  "receipt_state":receipt_state,
  "terminal":terminal,
  "runtime_hash":_tree_hash(root/"runtime/do_again"),
  "source_hash":_tree_hash(source/"src/do_again"),
}

if terminal:
    dry=run(["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",str(target)])
    out["dry_run"]={"rc":dry.returncode,"stdout":dry.stdout,"stderr":dry.stderr}

print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("SONARY_PENDING_REQUEST_DRAIN_AUDIT_OK")
